import os

# Search for any CSV files and any 'examples' directory
csv_files = []
examples_dirs = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.'):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
    if os.path.basename(root) == 'examples':
        examples_dirs.append(root)
    for f in files:
        if f.endswith('.csv'):
            csv_files.append(os.path.join(root, f))

print("'examples' dirs found:", examples_dirs)
print("\nCSV files found (up to 50):")
for c in csv_files[:50]:
    print(" ", c)
